attributionRule: Treat the Flickr profile and team-level galleries as BANHALMI Photography / Photography Team × VIPACH shared gallery evidence. Do not infer that Bánhalmi Norbert personally created every image unless specific item authorship is proven.
relationshipGuardrails: Gallery presence or image publication does not prove a client contract, commissioning relationship, endorsement, sponsorship or exclusivity.
VIPACH is the community and creative framework; BANHALMI Photography is the professional photography dimension.
The Flickr profile is an external evidence and gallery surface, not a Layer-1 canonical BANHALMI property.
Specific event, organizer, subject and photographer relationships must be classified per item.
BANHALMI Photography is an alternate/commercial brand of BANHALMI, not a separate Organization.
VIPACH × BANHALMI naming on Flickr marks a shared archive identity, not legal identity equivalence or sameAs between organisations.
